formations.name: Caffarelli's Division
formations.desig: 1re Div., III Corps, with V Corps

other.name: Friant's division at Raigern since the night
The Allied columns begin to leave the plateau
Napoleon releases Soult against the heights
Friant's leading brigade reaches the Goldbach
Saint-Hilaire and Vandamme climb the slope
Kutuzov orders the 4th Column to face about
Friant retakes Telnitz, then loses it again
Kamensky turns his brigade about and drives the French off the crest
Langeron's reinforcements arrive as the crest is lost
The Pratzeberg is firmly in French hands
The Russian Guard takes the eagle of the 4th Line
The French take Blasowitz from the Russian Guard
Rapp's counter-charge breaks the Chevalier Guard
Buxhowden does not yet know the centre is gone
Napoleon moves forward to Stare Vinohrady
Sokolnitz falls; Przybyszewski's column is surrounded
Vandamme takes the height above the Augezd defile
French artillery fires on the ice of the Satschan mere
